name: Physics Minor

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students complete a minimum of 14 upper division PHYS units, together with all the prerequisites for those courses.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students will select a reasonable list of courses that must be approved by the Department of Physics.

grades.label: Minimum Grade Requirement
grades.text: Students must maintain a cumulative GPA of at least 2.0 in courses required for the minor, as well as a cumulative GPA of at least 2.0 in all upper division courses required for the minor.
